label: dense; strongest when an o has been seen / o is being output
explanation: Dense feature: active on ~50% of all steps in essentially every sequence, with near-flat rates across phase, position, L, digits, and repeat counts. The only clear structure is a token-o component in the upper tail: it is active on 99.95% of steps that output o, and the strongest examples are sequences starting o o, where activation ramps up over the original tokens, peaks just before <DEL>, and decays through the copy phase. seen(o) | out_tok==o gives precision ~0.72 but only ~0.22 recall / 0.42 mass recall (dev). Other tokens (g, 3, u, 1, s, y) give weaker lifts. Most low-magnitude activations (lower quartiles) have no capturable pattern.
